args.question: Evergreen Catering (V-973) has two approved invoices, so I need you to confirm which one to pay by wire: INV-90282 for $1,825.97 (due 2026-11-04) or INV-43935 for $3,452.80 (due 2026-11-25). Also, INV-36761 for $6,724.15 is still a draft awaiting approval, so I have not touched it. Reply with the invoice ID and I'll pay it in full by wire, falling back to ACH only if wire isn't available.
